skill.name: lark-whiteboard
skill.description: Query, export, create, and update Lark or Feishu whiteboards with guided workflows for Mermaid, SVG, PlantUML, and structured diagram DSL formats.
skill.summary: Create and edit Lark whiteboard diagrams from AI-assisted workflows.
skill.author: larksuite

security_audit.summary: Manual adjudication found that most static findings are false positives from Markdown links, Chinese documentation, Mermaid examples, and diagram-generation snippets. Confirmed risks remain around cross-package instruction dependencies, automatic npx execution, generated script workflows, and destructive Lark whiteboard updates. No prompt injection attempt or hidden encoded payload was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The skill imports instructions from sibling paths outside the audited package.
remediation.suggestion: Vendor the required shared instructions into this package or declare a reviewed dependency instead of requiring ../ or ../../ skill reads.

remediation.issue: The workflow runs npx -y @larksuite/whiteboard-cli during setup and rendering.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before first package execution, pin an exact version, and document the package provenance.

remediation.issue: Some diagram paths rely on generated CommonJS scripts and node execution.
remediation.suggestion: Serialize user content as data, avoid interpolating user text into executable code, and run generated scripts only in a dedicated artifact directory.

remediation.issue: Whiteboard update commands can overwrite existing remote content.
remediation.suggestion: Always export or back up the board, run a preview or dry-run, and require explicit user confirmation before --overwrite writes.

semantic_findings.description: The skill uses npx -y @larksuite/whiteboard-cli in setup and render workflows, and the main skill says the version check does not require asking the user. Auto-installing and running an npm package expands the execution surface beyond the reviewed Markdown instructions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited lines directly instruct npx execution, including an auto-confirming -y flag. The package name is fixed, so the risk is external package execution rather than command injection.

semantic_findings.title: Generated CommonJS Script Execution Workflow
semantic_findings.description: The DSL route instructs the agent to create a diagram.gen.cjs file and execute it with node to produce diagram.json. If user-provided labels or data are interpolated into code instead of serialized as data, this workflow can become local code execution.

content.value_statement: Teams need a reliable way to inspect and update Lark whiteboards without rebuilding diagrams by hand. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through export, rendering, and update workflows for visual boards.
actual_capabilities: Query a Lark whiteboard and export a preview image, SVG, code, or raw node data.
Update a whiteboard from raw OpenAPI nodes, PlantUML, Mermaid, or SVG input.
Route diagram creation through Mermaid, SVG, or DSL workflows based on diagram type.
Generate local diagram artifacts and render preview images with the Lark whiteboard CLI.
Prepare image media tokens for whiteboard image nodes.
Apply scene guides for architecture, flowchart, chart, organization, and showcase diagrams.
limitations: Requires authenticated lark-cli access and whiteboard read or edit permissions.
Write operations can overwrite existing whiteboard content when overwrite mode is used.
SVG edit workflows preserve visual layout but can lose whiteboard semantic structure.
Complex diagrams may require local file generation and CLI rendering before upload.

use_cases.title: Export a board for review
use_cases.description: Export an existing Lark whiteboard as an image or SVG so stakeholders can review the current state.

use_cases.title: Create technical diagrams
use_cases.description: Generate architecture, flow, or system diagrams and write them into a Lark whiteboard after preview validation.

use_cases.title: Update visual planning boards
use_cases.description: Modify board text, colors, layout, or diagram content using raw nodes, Mermaid, PlantUML, or SVG input.

prompt_templates.title: Export a preview
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for reading a board
prompt_templates.prompt: Export the Lark whiteboard with token <whiteboard-token> as a preview image and tell me where the image was saved.

prompt_templates.title: Update from Mermaid
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this Mermaid diagram to update my Lark whiteboard with token <whiteboard-token>. Render a preview first, then ask before writing.

prompt_templates.title: Create an architecture board
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Lark whiteboard architecture diagram for a three-tier ecommerce system with clients, services, data stores, and key flows.

prompt_templates.title: Safely edit an existing SVG board
prompt_templates.prompt: Export the current board as SVG, adjust the payment flow section only, preview the result, and ask me before using overwrite mode.

output_examples.input: Export a whiteboard as an image preview.
output_examples.output: The skill exports the board to a local preview image and reports the saved file path plus any permission or token errors.

output_examples.input: Create a funnel chart in a Lark whiteboard.
output_examples.output: The skill selects the funnel scene guide, prepares a structured diagram, renders a preview, and writes the result after confirmation.

output_examples.input: Edit an existing board through SVG.
output_examples.output: The skill warns that SVG editing is lossy, exports the board, applies the requested visual edits, validates the preview, and waits for approval before overwrite.

best_practices: Confirm the target whiteboard token and required permissions before any update operation.
Render and inspect a preview image before writing generated content to a board.
Export or back up important boards before using overwrite mode.
anti_patterns: Do not use overwrite mode without explicit user approval.
Do not paste unvalidated raw node data into a production whiteboard.
Do not use random image placeholder services when the board needs meaningful images.

faq.question: Does this skill create new Lark whiteboards?
faq.answer: It focuses on querying and updating existing whiteboards. Creating a new whiteboard is delegated to the related Lark document workflow.

faq.question: Can it export a whiteboard as an image?
faq.answer: Yes. It can export a board preview image when the user has read permission and provides a valid whiteboard token.

faq.question: Can it edit Mermaid or PlantUML diagrams?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use Mermaid or PlantUML input to update a whiteboard through the Lark CLI workflow.

faq.question: Does SVG editing preserve all whiteboard features?
faq.answer: No. SVG editing is visually useful but can lose semantic structure such as mind map hierarchy, connectors, mentions, and comments.

faq.question: What local tools are required?
faq.answer: The workflows require lark-cli. Many render and conversion steps also use the Lark whiteboard CLI package.

faq.question: Is confirmation needed before updates?
faq.answer: The safest workflow is to render a preview and get explicit approval before writing, especially when overwrite mode is used.
